purpose: Successor mechanism study of what hard-capped level-crossing eventization preserves or loses in guided-wave SHM. Version 2.6 repairs the v2.5 terminal-hold contract failure by introducing a capacity-aware saturation precondition and explicitly untouched confirmation sources.

predecessor_invalidation.required_boundary: mechanism-v2.5 protocol, manifest, freeze receipt, source receipts, metadata gates, D12 result, calibration binding, and invalidation receipt are integrity history only. They cannot authorize v2.6 waveform access, schema decisions, caches, scores, or conclusions. D12 must not be rerun or recast as a blind confirmation.

research_question.from: Is SoD a competitive low-rate codec?
research_question.to: Under what verifiable hard-cap conditions does level-crossing eventization lose or preserve guided-wave damage information?
research_question.conclusion_form: Two pre-registered双向 outcomes: (A) event-native features retain task-specific information in a confirmation domain, or (B) quantization collision and packet truncation jointly cause information loss. Both are reported in full; no cherry-picking.

global_rules.system_boundary: Post-compensation software representation only. No MCU, ADC, acquisition power, embedded latency, energy, deployment, calibrated field FAR, or probability-of-detection claim is permitted.
global_rules.unit_of_analysis: monitoring record or predeclared monitoring block; paths, receivers, and repeated waveforms are components and never independent statistical samples

prohibited_uses: enter any v2.6 source receipt or runner input

global_rules.confirmation_rule: D16, MORPHO, and COQTEL are each processed once only under this frozen grid, followed immediately by their matching read-only result audit. A code defect invalidates the attempt and requires a named successor, never a silent rerun.
global_rules.historical_boundary: E7 and E8 remain immutable historical evidence. The aluminum 2021_03-to-2021_04 replay remains E8 only; 2021_05, 2021_06, 2022_07, and 2022_08 are ineligible for a healthy-to-damage confirmation claim.
global_rules.external_boundary: MORPHO and COQTEL first receive fresh v2.6 raw-byte receipts and metadata-only schema gates. No external waveform value, score, label-for-scoring, cache, E9 result, or signal conclusion is authorized by a historical receipt.
global_rules.execution_boundary: Only one writer may create a source receipt, metadata gate, cache, one-shot result, or audit in a v2.6 namespace. Existing v2.6 artifact paths always cause a safe refusal rather than overwrite or rerun.

historical_e7_binding.allowed_use: E7's existing healthy representation is immutable calibration provenance for D16 only. v2.6 produces a new calibration-binding receipt before E9; E7/E8 are never recomputed, edited, or represented as a new confirmation.

ogw_representation_contract.source: same 40 kHz high-pass, unit-energy-normalized OBS+BSS residual representation as strict-evaluation-v1

baseline_pool.selection: temperature-stratified deterministic selection frozen in the E7 strict-cache manifest

quantization.scale_fit: maximum absolute residual value over healthy training residuals only

payload_accounting.capacity_allocation: equal per-path cap including variable-length framing; choose the largest integer path cap whose framed worst-case total does not exceed the record capacity
payload_accounting.charge: actual serialized path timestamp gaps, signed level changes, path framing, and full record packet bytes
payload_accounting.cap_decoder_behavior: stop before the first event that would exceed the path cap and hold the final transmitted quantized level for the remaining samples

capacity_aware_terminal_hold.v2_5_lesson: The v2.5 terminal-hold probe failed at 8192-byte capacity because the first trace did not reach the hard cap while the second did. This violated the frozen saturation precondition and invalidated the D12 confirmation.
capacity_aware_terminal_hold.v2_6_repair: A capacity-aware terminal-hold generator whose saturation precondition is independently auditable for every declared capacity/delta BEFORE any waveform access.

pre_access_test.description: Before any new waveform scoring, run an independent test that verifies the saturation precondition for every (capacity, delta) grid cell.
pre_access_test.pass_criterion: For every declared capacity and delta, both probe traces must either (a) reach the hard cap with cap_saturated=true, or (b) be explicitly declared not_applicable with a documented reason.
pre_access_test.not_applicable_rule: If a capacity/delta cannot produce a saturated trace under the canonical probe construction, it is marked not_applicable and excluded from scoring. It may still carry a separate saturation-only proposition.
pre_access_test.failure_action: If any applicable cell fails the saturation test, the protocol must be revised (new version) before any waveform access. Do not relax the test after seeing failure.

probe_construction.trace_1: A reference signal that stays at a constant quantized level (no events), ensuring the payload is minimal (only the initial level).
probe_construction.trace_2: A divergent signal that introduces level changes spaced to fill the path cap, then continues with a different level pattern after the cap point.
probe_construction.verification: Both traces must be independently serialized by the frozen SodTransitionCodec; trace_2 must report cap_saturated=true; the post-cap suffix of trace_2 must differ from trace_1 in the original waveform domain.

diagnostic.normalization: per-feature median and MAD with a 1e-12 scale floor
diagnostic.head_reporting: always report both heads; neither may be selected after scoring

waveform_metrics.aggregation: record-level deterministic path aggregation defined in src.methods.mechanism_v2.record_waveform_metrics

loss_decomposition.quantization_only: input compared with unbounded quantized-level reconstruction
loss_decomposition.hard_cap_truncation: unbounded quantized-level reconstruction compared with bounded decoded reconstruction
loss_decomposition.score_head_mismatch: healthy-normalized dense/reconstructed waveform energy and the fixed event-native score are reported without labels

representation_propositions.quantization_collision: When two code paths have identical quantized level sequences, their SoD event time/level streams and serialized payload are identical. A canonical nonzero integer sub-level probe is reported as not applicable for delta_codes less than or equal to two.
representation_propositions.terminal_hold: After a hard path cap rejects an event, suffix waveform differences that do not alter the already serialized prefix cannot pass to the decoder; canonical divergent suffix evidence is required for every applicable capacity and delta. The capacity-aware generator must be pre-tested and audited before any waveform scoring.

healthy_control_injections.source: chronologically evenly spaced healthy OGW training records only
healthy_control_injections.interpretation: Representation probe only. It neither creates real damage evidence nor supports a diagnostic, operational, or deployment claim.

morpho_fod7.mapping_scope: metadata-only eligibility and predeclared path semantics before the one-shot runner; no HDF5 data/attribute values, waveform metric, event score, label cutoff selection, or result-dependent mapping choice
morpho_fod7.official_state_source: Official ReadMe: Healthy_Clamped/Healthy_Unclamped are healthy baselines; XkN_N subblocks are fatigue degradation states. Status is checked by attribute name only in the pre-score gate.
morpho_fod7.label_rule_for_future_one_shot_runner: Healthy_Clamped and Healthy_Unclamped map to label 0; the listed fatigue blocks map to label 1 solely by the frozen official path-token mapping, never by a value-derived threshold.
morpho_fod7.monitoring_group_definition: A fatigue/baseline block is the statistical monitoring group. Frequency, actuator, receiver channel, and the ten repeat datasets are within-block acquisition components and cannot create independent bootstrap samples.
morpho_fod7.repeat_split_rule: All components whose path has the same block token receive exactly one split assignment; no repeat, actuator, frequency, or receiver subcomponent may cross blocks/splits.

coqtel_corrosion.mapping_scope: metadata-only eligibility; no waveform values, score, binary label cutoff, or result-dependent choice
coqtel_corrosion.campaign_block_definition: One State_n within one named Essai_Corrosion campaign is a chronological monitoring component; the campaign remains the independent replication group and adjacent state records never become independent bootstrap units.
coqtel_corrosion.v2_6_policy: Schema gate may be reported as passed, but no ROC/AUC scoring is performed because no official binary healthy-versus-corroded cutoff exists in the frozen documentation. The schema gate result itself is a valid v2.6 artifact.
coqtel_corrosion.no_posthoc_cutpoint_rule: No temporal percentile, final-state comparison, visual trend, or signal score may create a healthy/corroded binary cutoff after schema access.

alarm_migration_assessment.purpose: Cross-period threshold stability assessment, NOT a healthy-to-damage confirmation.
alarm_migration_assessment.system_boundary: Software replay only. Reports false calls/day and coverage on independent healthy months. No operational alarm claim, PoD, or field FAR.
alarm_migration_assessment.rationale: These months are fully disjoint from the E8 calibration period. They test whether thresholds fitted on March 2021 generalize to an earlier independent healthy period with potentially different temperature distribution and plate conditions.

component_packet_definition.definition: One component packet is all 29 non-time receiver rows (HDF5 rows 1 through 29) from one frozen /5_Active/block/frequency/Actionneur/repeat dataset. The time row is excluded. A packet is an acquisition component, not an independent monitoring record.
component_packet_definition.capacity_application: Each component packet receives the same four E7 capacity conditions and its own framed per-path hard cap. The runner reports mean bytes per component packet, total bytes per monitoring block, and bits per original sample; component packet bytes are never treated as independent statistical observations.
component_packet_definition.block_score_aggregation: Arithmetic mean across every component packet in a block for each fixed global/max-path event score, dense energy score, and reconstruction energy score. Waveform/loss metrics are arithmetic means across components. Byte totals are summed within block and also reported as packet means.

healthy_only_fit.control_selection: Lexicographic component-packet order under the frozen frequency, actuator, repeat lists; these three ordinals and receiver positions are fixed before waveform access.

group_split.no_validation_selection: MORPHO has only two structurally distinct healthy Active blocks. No repeated component is repurposed as validation; this limitation is carried into every result.

external_execution_contract.label_construction: The runner may traverse frozen path tokens to score all packets, but constructs the binary label vector only after all held-out-normal and degradation block score arrays are materialized. Labels are solely the frozen path-token rule and have no threshold or configuration-selection role.
external_execution_contract.statistics: AUC, percentile 95% bootstrap interval, and paired score-head AUC difference are computed at the baseline/fatigue block group only. Frequency, actuator, receiver, and repeat data cannot create bootstrap draws.

schema_gate: sortable official fatigue-block path token and frozen block order
official Healthy group token and Status attribute name
official fatigue/degradation group tokens and Status attribute name
all ten repetitions for one block/frequency/actuator are components of that block and cannot cross a split
raw waveform path, sample axis, sampling-rate attribute name, and monitoring group identity are structurally recoverable
morpho.split: Fit only on Healthy_Clamped; evaluate held-out Healthy_Unclamped together with the frozen ordered fatigue blocks. No validation threshold or configuration selection exists, so no artificial third split is made from repeated measurements. Every repeat remains in its block group for all group-bootstrap calculations.
morpho.limitation: The data expose only two structurally distinct healthy Active blocks. Therefore the external result must report its one-held-out-healthy-block limitation and cannot be represented as a broad field generalization.

schema_gate: official EC_time/time-or-stage array structurally aligns with State_n groups
both named HDF5 experiments are present as independent campaign identifiers
raw waveform path, sample axis, sampling-rate attribute name, and state/campaign grouping are recoverable
adjacent 10-second states never become independent bootstrap samples
coqtel.v2_6_policy: Schema gate is reported. No ROC/AUC scoring is performed because no official binary healthy-versus-corroded cutoff is frozen. The schema qualification result itself is a valid artifact. If the user finds an official cutoff in later work, a new protocol version is required.
coqtel.no_posthoc_cutpoint_rule: No temporal percentile, final-state comparison, visual trend, or signal score may create a healthy/corroded binary cutoff after schema access.

copv.activation: permitted only when MORPHO fails its v2.6 schema gate before any waveform scoring
prohibited_activation: because an eligible dataset performs poorly
because COQTEL lacks a frozen binary cutoff while its metadata schema passed

statistics.binary_labeling: Only a predeclared official healthy versus official degradation/damage/failure stage may become a binary label. Mixed-label groups are invalid for group bootstrap.

group_bootstrap.unit: predeclared campaign/block or monitoring-record group, never path/receiver/repeat waveform

statistics.single_transition_metrics: If a single onset is reported, use only false calls/day, new-alarm delay, and coverage. Do not call it probability of detection or calibrated field FAR.

outcome_A_event_native_recovery.condition: event-native diagnostic AUC > 0.7 on confirmation set AND group bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0.6
outcome_A_event_native_recovery.conclusion: SoD is not a universal waveform codec, but its event-native features retain task-specific information in this confirmation domain.

outcome_B_mechanism_failure.condition: confirmation AUC <= 0.7 AND complete collision/terminal-hold evidence covers all applicable capacity/delta cells
outcome_B_mechanism_failure.conclusion: Quantization collision and packet truncation jointly cause information loss in this confirmation domain.

success_criteria.mandatory_reporting: Both outcomes, if their conditions are met, are reported in full. No cherry-picking of favorable cells, thresholds, or confirmation sources.

go_no_go: A high-level mechanism submission requires D16 and at least one external dataset (MORPHO schema-passed confirmation, or COQTEL schema qualification if MORPHO fails) to pass their predeclared schema/analysis gates and finish one once-only confirmation. If MORPHO schema fails, COPV may be activated only under the frozen fallback rule. The alarm migration assessment (2018_03/2018_04) is a supplementary descriptive artifact, not a substitute for mechanism confirmation. If the go/no-go is not met, retain a rigorous negative-result audit for a standard SHM venue; no hardware, power, real-time, deployment, PoD, or field-FAR conclusion is introduced.
